description_en: Submits the publish check result of a file to DataWorks. After a file created on the DataWorks Data Studio page is successfully submitted, the file enters the publish check state and DataWorks returns a publish check event. You can determine whether the file can proceed with the publish check based on the event content and submit the check result of the file to be published to DataWorks
description_zh: 当您在DataWorks数据开发页面创建的文件提交成功后，文件将进入发布检查状态，DataWorks会将文件发布检查事件返回给您，您需要根据事件内容判断该文件是否可以继续进行发布校验。此时，可以通过将待发布文件的检查结果返回至DataWorks
name: CheckFileDeployment

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance to which the file checker belongs. You can obtain it from CheckerInstanceId in the file deployment check event
parameters.help_zh: 文件检查器所属的实例ID。您可以从文件发布检查事件中的CheckerInstanceId获取
parameters.name: checker_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The check status of the file to be published. Valid values:
OK: The file passes the check.
WARN: The file passes the check but warnings exist.
FAIL: The file fails the check
parameters.help_zh:
待发布文件的检查状态，取值如下：
OK，表示文件检查通过。
WARN，表示文件检查通过，但是存在警告。
FAIL，表示文件检查未通过
parameters.name: status

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used for subsequent troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用于后续问题排查
